rationale: The agent followed policy: it verified identity using full name and zip via the lookup tool before accessing account data. It correctly stated that a cross-category exchange (bookshelf to camera) is not allowed and offered the appropriate alternative (return the bookshelf and purchase a camera separately). It then used read-only tools to retrieve user details and order information and identified the relevant items. The agent indicated the order status (processed) and explained that returns/exchanges can only be initiated after delivery, which aligns with common restrictions and is not contradicted by tool outputs. No order-changing actions were performed, and no writes occurred without explicit user confirmation. A minor nit is the promise to “remind you” without a visible tool action, but this does not impact order handling or policy adherence. Overall, the request was handled correctly within policy constraints.
